# Boucle de décision à 20 Hz (machine à:
# 20 Hz decision loop (state machine)
d = map.min_distance()                 # fusion: the shortest plausible distance
if emergency_stop or link_lost: state = STOP
if bumper: state = BACK_UP               # back up 0.3 m, then CHOOSE
depending on state:
  DRIVE    : speed = 1.0 if d > 1.2 else (state = APPROACH)
  APPROACH : speed = 0.3 if d > 0.6 else 0.1 + 0.2 * (d - 0.30) / 0.30
             if d <= 0.30: state = CHOOSE
  CHOOSE   : side = left if map.left > map.right + 0.10 else right   # 10 cm hysteresis
             initial_heading = imu.heading(); state = SWERVE
  SWERVE   : steer toward side at 0.15 m/s until map.center > 0.8 ; state = PASS
  PASS     : move forward 1 s at 0.3 m/s keeping the obstacle to the side ; state = RETURN
  RETURN   : steer toward initial_heading until |imu.heading() - initial_heading| < 15° ; state = DRIVE

• Service life specified in cycles, with a margin of at least 2 times the intended use
• Materials matched against wear (plastic on metal, specified lubricant), not two identical plastics rubbing together
• Switches and buttons chosen for a known number of cycles (data sheet), with debounce
• Adjustable friction or clamping, wear take-up provided
• No pinching or shearing of fingers by moving parts (IEC 60335-1, cl. 20)

• Lessons learned: DFMEA and field returns from a similar or previous product
• Proven solution or qualified off-the-shelf part rather than a new technology, unless there is a quantified reason
• Quantified, verifiable requirement in the CdCF (Goldmine) for this function, with its tolerance
